integrity: The universal inequality is established symbolically from Korselt squarefreeness/oddness, the stopping condition, and minimality of the least stopping divisor. The included computation is supplementary and does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the least stopping divisor and value ordering. It does not claim sharpness, a measured codec gain, or validity for heuristic stored divisors or frequency ordering. Finite enumeration is only a sanity check.
title: A depth hierarchy for stopping divisors in Carmichael prime wavelet trees
